title: Density bound at a weighted tangent point (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1); Step 5, second bullet, of the parent proof)
statement: Let Q, n ∈ ℕ and μ := Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^Q. Let M, C ⊆ ℝ^Q be μ-null-measurable with C ⊆ M, let θ : ℝ^Q → ℝ satisfy θ ≥ 0 on M, let y ∈ ℝ^Q with θ(y) > 0, and let T be a linear subspace of ℝ^Q which is the approximate tangent space of M at y with respect to θ (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T, Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7). Assume that some r > 0 has μ(C ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ and θ μ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_r(y), and that θ|C is continuous at y (ContinuousWithinAt θ C y). Then there is K ∈ ℝ≥0 such that μ(C ∩ B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ K · ofReal(ρⁿ) for all sufficiently small ρ > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (M C : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → C ⊆ M → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ x) → 0 < θ y → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞ ∧ IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → ContinuousWithinAt θ C y → ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C ∩ closedBall y ρ) ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
